name: Standing goal (webchat)
description: Hermes-style standing goal for gateway webchat: /goal command, optional judge + auto-continuation. Add to extensions.disabled to turn off.

continuationBody.default: Take the next concrete step toward the standing goal. Do not greet; focus on progress.
continuationBody.description: Body of the synthetic user message used for auto-continuation (a marker prefix is added).

maxAutoSteps.description: Max chained auto-continuations per standing goal (resets when the user sends a non-auto message).

judgeModelRef.description: Model ref for the judge LLM; defaults to agents.defaults.model when unset.
